Title: General availability: Azure Data Factory managed virtual network

Body.Content:
Azure Data Factory (ADF) managed virtual network is now generally available. With managed virtual network, you can provision the Azure Integration Runtime as part of a managed Virtual Network and leverage Private Endpoints to securely connect to supported data stores. Data traffic goes through Azure Private Links which provide secured connectivity to the data source. In addition, it prevents data exfiltration to the public internet. 

You can get more from Azure Data Factory managed virtual network.
